description.text: Teaching ObjectivesTo produce graduates with good business management skills that are efficient in Asia as well as in the rest of the world. The programs concentrate on personal development and the acquisition of business skills to: ensure that each student is challenged individually to attain the highest standards of personal excellence; introduce students to some basic humanities and social science courses that help them expand their perspective, and become responsible members of civil society; ensure that students learn to question assumptions and come up with creative and meaningful solutions; enhance learning by hands-on projects and teamwork.Main courses Foundation of Economics and Trading Theory; Corporate Strategy; Business Accounting; Programming Design Lab; International Marketing; Supply Chain Management; Microeconomics; Cognition Practice; Probability and Statistics; Applied Statistics; MacroeconomicsFor more curriculum details, please click here InternshipStudents will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, visits to companies, and career consultation.Degree AwardedBachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA).Future CareerThe graduates can work in the International trade transportation, insurance, customs clearance etc agencies, specialized foreign-trade corporations, and import and export department's of foreign-owned enterprises.

duration.text: The International Business at Shenyang Aerospace University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate You can click here to download the sample

requirements.text: 1. Applicants shall be younger than 25 years old.2. Applicants shall achieve a high school diploma or equivalent
